config.cooking-balancing.name: Cooking Balance
config.cooking-balancing.tooltip: Ensure cooking dishes always sell for at least the configured profit margin over raw ingredients.
config.cooking-margin.name: Cooking Margin
config.mead-fix.name: Mead Flavor & Value Fix
config.mead-fix.tooltip: Mead scales price based on the input honey flower type.
config.section.automation.name: Hopper Automation Features
config.auto-harvest.name: Enable Auto-Harvest
config.auto-harvest.tooltip: Allows hoppers to automatically pull and harvest finished products from all 4 adjacent machines (North, South, West, East) into the hopper or adjacent chests.
config.chest-output-transfer.name: Transfer to Adjacent Chests
config.chest-output-transfer.tooltip: Allows hoppers to automatically route and transfer collected items into any adjacent regular chest or mini-shipping bin.
config.periodic-processing.name: Background Periodic Automation
config.periodic-processing.tooltip: Allows hoppers to continuously check and process machines in the background without requiring player interaction or menu closures.
config.process-interval.name: Processing Interval (Ticks)
config.process-interval.tooltip: How frequently in game ticks background automation checks run (60 ticks = 1 real-world second).
config.section.machines.name: Special Machine Handling
config.service-crab-pots.name: Crab Pot Automation
config.service-crab-pots.tooltip: Allows hoppers to automatically load bait into adjacent crab pots and collect catches from them.
config.service-casks.name: Cask Automation
config.service-casks.tooltip: Allows hoppers to load aging ingredients into adjacent casks and harvest finished aged products from them.
config.section.customization.name: Hopper Customization
config.hopper-capacity.name: Hopper Inventory Capacity
config.hopper-capacity.tooltip: Total storage capacity of the hopper (36 slots vanilla default, or 70 slots expanded like Big Chest).
config.sound-effects.name: Play Sound Effects
config.sound-effects.tooltip: Plays subtle sound effects when items are automatically loaded into machines or harvested into chests.
